cancerfreeTote.name: APE 101 × CancerFree Tote
cancerfreeTote.story: A physical collaboration connecting character, health advocacy and everyday use. It is preserved here as a record of something made together; its production year and full story are still being documented.
cancerfreeTote.alt: Physical APE 101 and CancerFree collaboration tote
cancerfreeTote.character: BAYC #8796 appears in the tote artwork.

cancerfreeBadge.name: APE 101 × CancerFree Badge
cancerfreeBadge.story: A physical display recorded during ApeFest 2023. The green badge brings CancerFree Biotech and BAYC #8796 together in a small object made to travel and be remembered.
cancerfreeBadge.alt: APE 101 and CancerFree green badges with black caps at ApeFest 2023

gioiaPanLook.name: GIOIA PAN 2023 AW Ocean Heart Look
gioiaPanLook.story: On 8 April 2023, GIOIA PAN presented Ocean Heart at Tamsui Fisherman’s Wharf. With authorization from the owner of BAYC #8796, designer Gioia Pan translated the character into textile imagery and a runway appearance, bringing a digital collectible into physical fashion.
gioiaPanLook.alt: GIOIA PAN 2023 AW runway looks featuring BAYC #8796 imagery
gioiaPanLook.character: The owner of BAYC #8796 authorized Gioia Pan to use the character.
gioiaPanLook.videoCaption: BAYC #8796 appearing in the GIOIA PAN AW23 runway show
gioiaPanLook.videoUsage: Non-commercial derivative use; character use authorized by the owner of BAYC #8796.
